source_boundary: Public information available through 2026-10-12; primary company filings/IR preferred; secondary sell-side/media used only as corroboration/proxy where primary text was not directly indexed.

research_sweeps.angle: Latest overseas cybersecurity earnings + AI infrastructure/security demand
material_new_items: Fortinet 2Q26 revenue $2.05B +26% YoY; product revenue $773M +52%; billings +33%.
Fortinet says AI is a dominant driver of security infrastructure modernization; disclosed an 8-figure neocloud AI-datacenter security win after a 7-figure Q1 deal.
CrowdStrike FY27 Q2 revenue $1.471B +26%, net new ARR $333M +51%; CEO called Q2 the best quarter in company history and said AI adoption needs security.
CrowdStrike AIDR business reported >79x growth in three quarters since launch (Oct. 7, 2026 release).
Palo Alto Networks FY26 Q4 said AI advances are elevating cybersecurity to the top of the CIO priority list.
research_sweeps.stop_reason: Primary IR evidence converged on both hardware/network modernization and AI-native software/runtime security demand.

research_sweeps.angle: 2026 H1 domestic filings; AI-security commercialization and peer universe
material_new_items: 启明星辰: H1 revenue RMB1.235B +9.01%, net profit RMB30.8M vs loss; large-model application firewall revenue +238.15%, Agentic SOC revenue +31.99%.

绿盟科技: H1 revenue RMB812.6M +1.51%, net loss RMB129.0M with loss narrowing 24.77%; AI-security orders RMB117M; operator AI-security signings +300%+, but report explicitly says revenue conversion efficiency was under pressure.

深信服: H1 revenue RMB3.998B +32.85%, net profit RMB231.2M vs loss; cloud+AI infrastructure revenue RMB2.212B +58.60%; network-security revenue RMB1.587B +10.57%; no separate AI-security revenue disclosure. Firewall processing performance improved 50%-100%.
安恒信息: H1 pure-AI revenue >RMB41M and indirect AI-enabled product revenue >RMB64M; total revenue RMB739.1M +0.86%, loss narrowed.
奇安信: H1 revenue RMB1.497B -14.09%, loss narrowed; product AI-ization underway but no quantified AI-security monetization found in checked H1 disclosures.
亚信安全: network-security segment revenue RMB540M +6%; AI-agent identity/AIXDR products advancing, but total consolidated revenue -12.40% and no quantified AI-security sales in checked disclosure.
research_sweeps.stop_reason: Second sweep added material peer 安恒信息 and showed that domestic AI-security monetization quality differs materially across revenue, orders, and product/technology progress.

market_explanation_scope_reason: The task is an industry-demand/earnings/commercialization article, not a cross-sectional stock-price leadership or limit-up explanation. Company comparison is based on business exposure and monetization evidence, not price formation.

what_changed: AI security is no longer only a threat narrative: overseas vendors now show simultaneous acceleration in high-performance security hardware, ARR, and AI-native security products.

AI datacenter east-west traffic, encrypted traffic and AI-agent privileges increase throughput/visibility/control requirements, pushing network-security modernization beyond a routine replacement cycle.
Domestic AI-security commercialization entered 2026 H1 reports, but evidence is uneven: revenue at 启明星辰/安恒, orders at 绿盟, broader AI-infrastructure and security growth at 深信服.
transmission_chain: AI compute/data-center expansion → more east-west/encrypted/machine traffic + higher-value model/data assets
AI agents/models move into production → new identity, prompt-injection, data-leakage, runtime and governance attack surfaces
Security requirement moves from perimeter-only to data center + gateway + model/application + endpoint/identity/runtime
Customers refresh high-throughput firewalls and consolidate onto AI-native security platforms
Vendor monetization appears first as hardware/product revenue, ARR/orders, then domestic revenue recognition
counterevidence: China cybersecurity budgets remain constrained in several traditional government/enterprise segments; 奇安信 H1 revenue fell 14.09%.
绿盟 AI-security order growth has not fully converted into revenue; company explicitly cites delayed investment structure and conversion pressure.
深信服's high cloud+AI infrastructure growth cannot be equated one-for-one with AI-security revenue.
AI model/cloud providers may also embed native security and compete with third-party vendors; Palo Alto 10-K explicitly identifies this competitive risk.
uncertainties: Absolute revenue base of 启明星辰 large-model application firewall is not separately disclosed in checked sources; +238.15% is a growth rate, not scale.
绿盟 AI-security orders may convert to revenue with lag; timing and gross margin are not fully disclosed.

How much of Fortinet product acceleration is AI-specific versus broader refresh/vendor consolidation is not separately quantified; management says it is larger than normal refresh but product revenue is not segmented by AI.
Domestic Q3 2026 reports for key names had not yet been fully disclosed as of 2026-10-11/12; H1 is the latest comparable reporting base for the named A-share companies.

recall_sources: 2026 H1 listed-company filings/official IR across named and peer A-share cybersecurity vendors
2026 overseas vendor earnings releases/prepared remarks and current AI-security product releases
